A.name: Stack A: Sovereign Design-to-Deploy
A.tagline: Penpot designs the brand system, Directus serves structured CMS content, Gitea runs Git/CI, Nginx Proxy Manager routes domains & SSL.

B.name: Stack B: Rapid Visual Web & Brand CMS
B.tagline: WordPress builds visual landing pages, Ghost publishes SEO blogs, Strapi powers custom frontends, Uptime Kuma monitors live uptime & SSL.

penpot.name: Penpot
penpot.role: Open-source Figma alternative for UI/UX design systems, logos & wireframes
penpot.first_run: Open the link and click 'Create an account' to start your local design workspace.

directus.name: Directus
directus.role: Headless CMS & instant REST/GraphQL backend for brand web apps
directus.first_run: Log in with admin@techstarz101.local and the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD in tools/directus/.env.

gitea.name: Gitea
gitea.role: Self-hosted Git server & CI/CD Actions runner for brand web repos
gitea.first_run: Click 'Install Gitea' on first visit (Postgres is pre-wired) and register your local admin account.

nginx-proxy-manager.name: Nginx Proxy Manager
nginx-proxy-manager.role: Visual domain routing, reverse proxy & automated Let's Encrypt SSL
nginx-proxy-manager.first_run: Default admin login: admin@example.com / changeme (prompts immediately to update).

wordpress.name: WordPress
wordpress.role: Open-source visual web builder & rapid landing page engine
wordpress.first_run: Complete the 1-minute WordPress site title & admin setup wizard on first visit.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.role: Modern SEO-first brand publishing, blog & newsletter platform
ghost.first_run: Open /ghost to create your publication owner account and pick a brand theme.

strapi.name: Strapi
strapi.role: Open-source headless CMS & API builder for custom React/Next.js/Astro sites
strapi.first_run: First boot installs Strapi into the volume (~60s), then open /admin to create your super admin.

uptime-kuma.name: Uptime Kuma
uptime-kuma.role: Real-time website, SSL certificate & DNS uptime monitoring + status pages
uptime-kuma.first_run: Create your local admin password on first visit and add monitors for your live deployed domains.
